name: Raspberry Pi AI Camera
description: A 12.3 MP Sony IMX500 camera that runs neural networks (object detection, pose) on the sensor itself and returns tensor metadata with each frame. The host Pi stays free for the rest of the robot software.

variants.note: Ships with 200 mm cables for both 15-pin and 22-pin CSI connectors

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Modes: 4056×3040 at 10 fps, 2028×1520 binned at 30 fps. The model input is up to 640×640 int8, with about 8 MB for firmware, weights and working memory.
Manual focus from 20 cm to infinity. 4.74 mm F1.79 lens, 66.3°×52.3° (H×V), 78.3° diagonal. Has an IR-cut filter.
An onboard RP2040 manages the network firmware. Works with every Raspberry Pi that has a CSI connector.
